description: Get pit stop data for a specific race. Can return all pit stops or a specific stop number. Data available from 2012 onwards.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 30, max 1000)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

stop.description: Specific pit stop number (omit for all stops)
